P-ENCLOSURE.evidence: Tall walls on both sides and a rear wall create defined edges, forming a clear enclosed outdoor room around the pool and deck.

P-LAYERS.evidence: Only two isolated potted plants are visible; no trees, shrubs, or ground cover layers are present. The planting is sparse and lacks depth.

P-FOCAL.evidence: The long, rectangular swimming pool acts as a strong central axis, drawing the eye through the space and organizing the surrounding deck and gravel areas.
